Rank 27 - Event

Community Center and Wedding Hall Booking

Venue owners need date hold, booking advance, due, package, decorator/catering note, and calendar visibility.

Calculate revenue Open overview

Suggested package

BDT 15,000Installation/setup fee
BDT 800Recommended monthly charge

BDT 800/month is practical because one avoided double booking can save much more.

6.7Practical score based on daily pain, willingness to pay, support load, and expansion potential.
BDT 15,000Default setup used in calculator.
BDT 800Suggested monthly price after support-cost thinking.
BDT 7,380,000Gross year-one revenue at 1,000 businesses.

Why this can work

Target community centers, convention halls, rooftop venues, catering halls, and decorators handling date bookings.

Dates get double-booked or held without clear advance and due status.

No double booking, clear advance, clear due, clear event date.

Validation signals

  • Wedding/event booking is recurring.
  • Double-booking pain is high.
  • Venues can pay more than micro shops.
  • Calendar UI is easy to demonstrate.

MVP modules

  • Booking calendar
  • Date hold
  • Customer profile
  • Package
  • Advance/due
  • Event note
  • Monthly booking report

Do not build first

  • Do not build public marketplace first.
  • Do not add payment custody.
  • Do not add complex event planning.

Money model

Change the inputs and see the business case instantly.

Use support cost as a reality check. Low monthly pricing looks attractive until support eats the margin.

Risks and fixes

Risks
  • Seasonality.
  • Custom packages.
  • Owner/staff communication.
Mitigations
  • Annual contract.
  • Simple package templates.
  • Owner notifications.
